name: Kiryū (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kiryū city emblem in white: an outlined lozenge-shaped device with a flower at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Kiryū, a city in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 October 1928.

features.role: Kiryū city emblem — an outlined lozenge-shaped device with a flower at the top
